begin_of_turn_query.content: My tires need to be in top-notch condition before embarking on my journey. Could you ensure they have optimum pressure? If any tire falls short of 30.0 psi, it’s off to the nearest service station to remedy it pronto. Let’s also ready the car for navigation if the shop isn't miles away!
